title: Catch-up spool controller owes the verified-offer keystone that replaced fn-cu-step-keeps-offers-verified (deleted with the in-memory round): fn-csp-step offers a record (IHAVE or body to the local node) only from a batch whose spooled records chain from the committed chain to the peer's claim. Needs a spool-content model threaded through the step (the spool octets since the batch began) and CSP-OWED-SPOOL-DIGEST. Witnessed, not proved: tests/acl2/peer-catchup-tests.lisp (the A1/A2 exchange).
